title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: Yannic Kilcher walks through the Attention Is All You Need paper, which introduced the Transformer, a sequence model based solely on attention without recurrence or convolutions. He reviews the architecture and the paper's translation results.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible, clear walkthrough of the transformer paper for people with some AI background.

quote.text: The Yannic kilcher review is quite good.
